title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-20
lineage: reel > AKAI GX625 > Apogee Mini Me (24/96) > Apogee Mini  Dac (monitoring) > Wavelab 5.0 (dithered to 16/44) > CD > EAC > Wav > Flac16
source: MR > R Heavily Edited > R @ 71/2ips > CD

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording is marred by a noticeable half‑tone pitch error, yet the acoustic portion—particularly an acoustic Truckin'—offers tasty moments.
ai_review.review: The three reviews are split: two critics slam this version for being out of tune and inferior to the Sirmick remaster, calling it a poor upgrade. The third reviewer enjoys the acoustic set, highlighting acoustic Truckin' and a train‑whistle intro to Casey Jones, suggesting the performance itself has bright spots despite the technical flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality gets modest praise (acoustic set), but recording quality is judged poor due to pitch problems; mixed feedback from three reviews yields a middling rating with medium confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Pitch runs about half‑tone low, making the mix sound off. Reviewers prefer the Sirmick remaster, indicating this file is not an improvement and suffers from noticeable tuning issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The acoustic set is singled out as tasty, with particular enjoyment of the unplugged Truckin' and vocal delivery; no major structural complaints are noted.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir's vocals on acoustic Truckin' are praised for their grit.
